title: Implement Json File Kit Store And Wire Vscode Kit Editor
description: Implement JsonFileKitStore in semio/studio/studio.ts as a UndoableKitStore backed by JSON file I/O. Wire the semio/vscode extension to use JsonFileKitStore + embedded Sketchpad webview when opening *.kit.json files. Add tests for JsonFileKitStore. Update filename patterns and exports.
summary: Implemented JsonFileKitStore in studio.ts with full UndoableKitStore contract (undo/redo, transact, save, reload, applyExternalUpdate). Created webview.tsx entry point mounting Sketchpad with JsonFileKitStore via VS Code postMessage adapter. Rewrote extension.ts with CustomTextEditorProvider bridging file I/O via message protocol. Updated vite.config.ts with dual-mode build (extension + webview). All 48 tests pass. Both builds succeed.
